replays.label: a. Scripted flock, plain world
replays.description: The hand-written reference policy (it is told where the water is) on the plain world with 3 willows per pond, 3 days. What competent use of the meadow looks like.

replays.label: b. Scripted flock, stage 2a world (mud 8 + fog)
replays.description: The scripted flock on stage 2a's world: a mud ring of 8 tiles round each pond (no grass there) and 3 days in 4 foggy, 5 days. The positive control for the memory rule: it knows where the water is, so it returns from beyond the ring in fog without searching.

replays.label: c. Stage-1 brain A3, plain world
replays.description: The stage-1 brain A3 (embed hybrid: world model + PPO, trained with willows) on the plain world, 3 days. It finds and uses the water it can see.

replays.label: d. Stage-2a brain, mud ring 8
replays.description: The stage-2a brain s2a_s0 (GRU column added, trained on the mud ramp up to 8 tiles) with the 8-tile mud ring, clear days, 5 days. It grazes beyond the mud and comes back to drink.

meta.label: d. Stage-2a brain, mud ring 8

replays.label: e. Stage-2a brain in fog (before fog training)
replays.description: The same stage-2a brain s2a_s0 on the fog world (mud 8, 3 days in 4 foggy), 5 days, before any fog training: in the evaluations 39-67 % of the sheep die within 5 days.

meta.label: e. Stage-2a brain in fog (before fog training)
meta.description: The same stage-2a brain s2a_s0 on the fog world (mud 8, 3 days in 4 foggy), 5 days, before any fog training: in the evaluations 39-67 % of the sheep die within 5 days.

replays.label: f. Fog-trained brain s2f in fog
replays.description: The fog-trained brain s2f_s0 (continued from s2a_s0 with the fog probability ramped to 0.75) on the fog world (mud 8), 5 days. It survives by grazing where the mud ring stays visible in fog and keeping its hydration near full.

meta.label: f. Fog-trained brain s2f in fog

replays.label: g. Fog-trained brain s2f, thirst x3
replays.description: The fog-trained brain s2f_s0 on the fog world (mud 8) with hydration decaying three times faster, 5 days. The sheep stay closer to the water still; in the evaluations 34 % die.

replays.label: h. Scripted flock, river meadow (72 tiles, skyline)
replays.description: The scripted flock on the river meadow (spec section 21.8): 72 x 72 tiles, one straight river through the centre at a random angle, uncrossable, willows along both banks, a mud band of 8 tiles, the skyline on; clear days, 3 days. The layout only: the scripted policy knows where the water is. Nothing has trained on this world yet.

replays.label: i. Skyline-trained brain s2k in fog, skyline on
replays.description: The skyline-trained brain s2k_s2 (continued from the fog brain with three fixed peaks on the horizon, spec section 21.7) on the fog world (mud 8, 3 days in 4 foggy), 5 days, the skyline on. The seed with the best survival (4.7 % dead) and the clearest ablation effect.

replays.label: j. Skyline-trained brain s2k in fog, skyline blanked
replays.description: The same brain s2k_s2 on the same world with the skyline blanked at evaluation (the ablation of section 21.7): night returns from 12-16 and 16-24 tiles were 19-24 % slower without it in the evaluations, survival unchanged.
